# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 24 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 24 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_024_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 24

**24:1** Now I, James, who have written this history — when the upheaval arose in Jerusalem at the death of Herod, I withdrew into the wilderness until the commotion in Jerusalem had subsided. I glorified the Lord God, who gave me wisdom to write this history.

**24:2** Grace be with all those who fear the Lord. Amen.
